issue.title: just check feature-flag gate hits pager circular import while listing flag beads
issue.description: During disk_footprint module-splitting verification, just check passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, and mypy, then failed deterministically at lint (feature flags). Re-running just check reproduced the same failure: tools/check_feature_flags invokes BD_COMMAND=tools/sase_bead to list flag beads, and .venv/bin/sase bead imports sase.pager while it is partially initialized, ending with ImportError: cannot import name 'PagerDocument' from partially initialized module 'sase.pager'. This is unrelated to the disk_footprint diff, whose focused test passes.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: The same just check feature-flag gate failed twice on the same tree with the same deterministic ImportError before any pytest lane; this is a lint/import-cycle failure, not an intermittent test.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction during commit_repair module-splitting verification at 2863ed2f19a2431baeff25cca3f943f44e3e81c8: just check again passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, and mypy, then failed at lint (feature flags) because tools/check_feature_flags invoked tools/sase_bead and hit ImportError importing PagerDocument from partially initialized sase.pager. My diff only moves src/sase/finalizers/commit_repair.py internals into helper modules.

Independent reproduction during continuation_budget.py module-splitting verification at 4cd297ada2: just check passed fmt, ruff, and mypy, then failed at lint (feature flags) with the same ImportError importing PagerDocument from partially initialized sase.pager. Verified via git stash that this reproduces identically on unmodified master (no continuation_budget changes applied), and persists after a fresh 'just install'. My diff only splits src/sase/llm_provider/continuation_budget.py into sibling request/projection/decision/persistence modules.
